t: Professional 2-step mould treatment kit to target both visible stains and invisible fungal structure to permanently resolve problems. Results in rapid elimination of mould stains, followed by the creation of a long-lasting fungicidal barrier. Allows treated surfaces to remain hygienic and mould free for up to 12 months. Ideal for treatment on walls and ceilings prior to redecoration. Includes 10 litres of mould treatment solutions, protective gloves, and a 7 litre sprayer for easy and efficient application.
